name: Orbs
description: Compact animated activity indicators for agent UIs — discrete DOM and CSS orbs that signal what the agent is doing without blocking the thread.
styling: Plain CSS with CSS custom properties (design tokens). No Tailwind, no UI libraries, no external dependencies. Theme-aware via [data-theme] (light/dark).
